stemMd: The review did more than disagree: its sneering language was openly ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Sneering indicates contempt rather than simple disagreement. Contemptuous and scornful therefore give equivalent meanings grounded in the stated tone.

distractorRationale.e: Subject matter is not the tone being described.
distractorRationale.b: The response is described as open and forceful.
